builds.statsNote: Read on 8 Oct 2026, before the Omni Forma reset. The panel leaves out weak points and conditional mods.
builds.slots: Slot 1 Madurai, slot 7 Naramon, locked Exilus Naramon, slot 5 Omni (Hellfire drains 6 instead of 11), the rest neutral.
notes: Removing Gilded Truth halves the fire rate (8 to 4).
At 60 capacity, maxed Hellfire and Infected Clip beat Hammer Shot on total damage.
Critical Delay gives +200% crit chance for -20% fire rate.
Argon Scope gives +135% crit chance for 9 seconds after a headshot while aiming (database current to about March 2025).
